acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced thiols were alkylated with 40 mM chloroacetamide and sample were diluted with 25 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10% acetonitrile to obtain a final GdmCl concentration of 0.6 M.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Reduced thiols were alkylated with 40 mM chloroacetamide and sample were diluted with 25 mM Tris/HCl, pH 8.5, 10% acetonitrile to obtain a final GdmCl concentration of 0.6 M.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with 1 µg Trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega) overnight at 37°C under gentle agitation.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were loaded on multi-stop-and-go tip (StageTip) containing three C18-disks and three SCX-disks.

fragmentation_method.evidence: inferred: MS data were recorded by data dependent acquisition. The full MS scan range was 300 to 2000 m/z with resolution of 70000, and an automatic gain control (AGC) value of 3*10E6 total ion counts with a maximal ion injection time of 100 ms.

ionization_type.evidence: Liquid chromatography / mass spectrometry (LC/MS) was performed on Thermo Scientific™ Q Exactive Plus equipped with an ultra-high performance liquid chromatography unit (Thermo Scientific Dionex Ultimate 3000) and a Nanospray Flex Ion-Source (Thermo Scientific).

labeling.value: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method
labeling.evidence: quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

ptm.evidence: N-terminal acetylation (+42.01), and oxidation of methionine (+15.99) were selected as variable modifications and carbamidomethylation (+57.02) on cysteines as a fixed modification.
